summary: Visually solid, defect-light dark title slide: correct title/speaker/dept present, true dark gradient palette, a clean 3-layer SVG wave motif at the bottom with no broken paths or stray artifacts, no overflow (scrollW/H exactly 1280x720), no console output, and all text passes contrast (title 15.8:1, subtitle 12.5:1, kicker 10.7:1, dept 5.2:1 at 22px) with every size >= 20px. t0/t2/t5 are byte-identical, which is correct for a static slide. Deductions are for content fidelity rather than rendering: an invented 'A TALK ON MARINE SCIENCE' kicker that the prompt never asked for, the affiliation silently expanded from 'Dept.' to 'Department', and a text block centered on the full canvas rather than the area above the wave band.
